# Role Color Finder

> Discover your professional identity through the Role Color assessment framework.

## Metadata

- Description: A psychometric and professional development platform that categorizes career roles into color-coded archetypes to improve team dynamics and individual career alignment.
- Topics: Career Development, Psychometrics, Team Management, Professional Coaching
- Audience: Professionals, HR Managers, Career Coaches, Teams
- Language: en
- Contact: https://rolecolorfinder.com/about
- Sitemap: https://rolecolorfinder.com/sitemap
